signal: Zamp launched its global sales tax operating system, Zamp OS, alongside $30M in funding led by Acrew Capital with Thomson Reuters Ventures

email.body1:
Matt, saw Zamp launched Zamp OS globally alongside the $30M round led by Acrew and Thomson Reuters Ventures.

Launching globally on fresh capital usually puts more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Zamp off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matt, quick follow-up for Zamp.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Zamp needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matt, last bit of proof for Zamp.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Zamp's reply rate likely compares to other fintech and compliance software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matt, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Launching globally right after a raise is its own kind of busy, and I get it.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Zamp either way.
